meta.title: OpenClaw × Clink — Real-World Errands With Scoped Payment Authority
meta.description: OpenClaw runs around the clock. Clink gives it scoped payment authority for the errands you delegate—orders, pickups, and paid services.
meta.ogDescription: An always-on agent doesn't stop at answers. Clink gives OpenClaw scoped payment authority for orders, pickups, and paid services.

hero.h1: OpenClaw Buys Within the Lines You Draw.
hero.standfirst: An always-on runtime doesn't stop at answers. Clink gives OpenClaw scoped payment authority for the errands you delegate—orders, pickups, and paid services.
hero.ctaLabel: See an Errand End to End

capabilities.title: An Always-On Agent Can Carry Errands to Completion.
capabilities.body: OpenClaw is already running when the errand appears. Clink closes the last gap: a controlled way to pay for the order, the service, or the top-up the task calls for.

blocks.title: From Errand to Executable Plan.
blocks.body: Say the errand the way you'd text a friend. OpenClaw turns it into a plan—what to buy, from where, by when—and Clink turns the plan into an approvable payment.

visual.heading: OpenClaw errand
visual.prompt: Order my usual from the %Arabica near the office for a 4 p.m. pickup, under $15.

blocks.title: Authority That Expires With the Errand.
blocks.body: Each errand gets its own authorization: merchant, amount, and a validity window. When the window closes, the authority closes with it—no standing card access.

blocks.title: Order Status Back in the Conversation.
blocks.body: The errand ends with proof, not a promise: a pickup code, an order confirmation, or the fulfilment status—delivered where you asked OpenClaw.

setup.title: Teach Your Agent to Buy.
setup.body: Connect the agent you already use to Clink through MCP. Connector setup is coming next.
setup.thenAsk: “Order my usual %Arabica for a 4 p.m. pickup and send me the code.”

items.title: Order Ahead on the Way
items.body: Coffee, lunch, or a scheduled pickup—OpenClaw places the order and hands you the code before you arrive.

items.title: Restock the Essentials
items.body: Household or workspace items that run out on a rhythm can be reordered inside a standing cap.

items.title: Find the Gift Inside the Budget
items.body: Give the person, the occasion, and the ceiling. OpenClaw narrows the options and completes the approved purchase.

items.title: Pay for the Services the Agent Uses
items.body: When an errand needs a paid API or tool, the purchase happens per use inside the same authorization.

items.title: Trip Prep Without Tab-Switching
items.body: Adapters, SIMs, last-minute items—delegated as a list and purchased within one trip budget.

items.title: Standing Errands on a Weekly Cap
items.body: Recurring errands run against a weekly allowance instead of a fresh approval every time.

howTo.title: Say the Errand. Approve the Lines. Get the Proof.
howTo.description: Three steps, and the errand ends with something you can act on—a code, an order, or a receipt.

steps.name: Say the Errand in Plain Words
steps.text: What to buy, from where, by when, and the ceiling—stated like a message to an assistant, not a checkout form.

steps.name: Approve Merchant, Amount, and Window
steps.text: This is the OpenClaw difference: the authorization carries a validity window and expires with the errand, and pickup errands return a code you can act on.

steps.name: Get the Pickup Code or the Receipt
steps.text: The errand closes with proof—pickup code, order confirmation, or receipt—filed where you can find it later.

faqs.q: Is It Safe to Let an Always-On Agent Spend?
faqs.a: Always-on does not mean unguarded. Every purchase is scoped to one errand, budgets and frequency caps apply across errands, and unusual patterns pause automatic funding until you review.
Orders on supported commerce surfaces such as Shopify storefronts, pickup orders with connected partners in APAC, and API products paid per use. Availability depends on merchant and location.
Yes. Authorizations expire on their own, and you can revoke an agent's payment access at any time from the wallet. Past purchases remain visible for review.

finalCta.title: Give OpenClaw the Errands. Keep the Authority.
finalCta.description: Delegate real purchases with scoped, expiring payment authority—and get proof every time.
